accuracy.evidence: Bond counts follow 8 minus outer electrons (C4,N3,O2,Cl1,H1); O2 double, N2 triple, CO2 two doubles; NH3 one lone pair; shared-electron sums checked at param corners.

misconceptions.evidence: Targets: covalent bonding described as electron transfer (ionic), hydrogen given 8 instead of 2, a single bond drawn in O2 or N2, and metal/non-metal pairs treated as covalent.

lab_distinct.evidence: Molecule builder: tap two atoms to share pairs, up to a triple bond, with per-atom outer-count rings and lone pairs drawn; unlike the shell lab there is no electron placement into shells.

lab_teaches.evidence: Learners make Cl2, H2O, NH3 and O2 themselves and see each ring turn green only when the count reaches 8 (2 for H), which makes the 8-minus rule something they find for themselves.

predictions.evidence: 'Chlorine gives one away', '8 bonds for nitrogen' and 'one pair is enough for O2' are all tempting, and the build disproves each one.

challenge_feedback.evidence: There are separate messages for hydrogen with two bonds, an atom over 8, a disconnected atom, and a named atom that is still short, with a hint to use a multiple bond.

readability.evidence: Kid text uses short sentences built on the Cl2 sharing example; adult paragraphs each give one idea, ending with the common slips.

no_filler.evidence: Every sentence states a fact or a rule tied to a named molecule; there is no generic 'great job' or templated phrasing, and the explanation does not overlap the other lessons.

mobile.evidence: Covalent bonding lab checked on iPhone 13 and a 360x640 Android viewport, dark and light, all 6 steps: NH3 and CH4 atoms are now spread between the title and hint strips with the ring radius shrunk so rings never touch (the earlier NH3 layout had its bottom H ring overlapping the N ring); the hint pill sits in its own bottom strip clear of the 1/2 badges; the Guide launcher is a slim edge tab that does not cover the canvas, buttons or text; the Share between selects and the add/remove buttons wrap and stay reachable.

accessibility.evidence: The canvas aria-label and live region state each molecule's bonds and every atom's outer-electron count (e.g. 'NH3: no bonds yet. Outer electrons: N 5 of 8; H1 1 of 2...'); bonds are made with the 'Share between' selects and '+ share a pair' / '- take a pair back' buttons, so no tap on the canvas is needed; ring colour is paired with the n/8 text badge, not colour alone; scripts/pipeline/walk.cjs reports axe WCAG 2.1 AA violations: none on desktop and phone, in both themes.

sources: BBC Bitesize: Covalent bonding (dot and cross diagrams)
